topic: A lab name alone doesn't complete the testing line on a certificate.

scenes.headline: Lab name only?
scenes.note: Say a seller's cert names the lab and nothing else.

scenes.headline: What the test line needs
scenes.note: Date, plus each lab's address, email and phone.

scenes.headline: Every lab it relies on
scenes.note: 16 CFR 1110.11(a)(6): most recent date and place.

scenes.headline: Testing line check
scenes.note: Say KID-24-BLUE's cert lists the lab's name only.

vo: Lab name only? That's half the line.
The cert needs the most recent test date, and each lab's address, email and phone.
Every lab the certificate depends on.
Say yours shows only the name. That's a gap.

caption:
A lab name alone doesn't complete the testing line on a certificate.
Under 16 CFR 1110.11(a)(6), the certificate gives the most recent date and place of testing, including for each third party lab it depends on: name, street address, city, country, email and phone.
Missing details there leave the certificate incomplete.
Check it before the next shipment.
